svg.text: PLACEHOLDER · characters: aria, bram, sylfie · seed: None

text.tspan: Aria's feet frozen in clear ice blocks on grass, looking down
sheepish. Bram tall and lanky offering a thermos, glasses
glinting, pockets bulging. Sylfie in background skating
effortlessly on a frozen puddle, ribbons floating. Golden hour
light. Characters: ARIA: human girl 7-8, small stocky build,
warm beige skin with nose freckles, messy chin-length chestnut
bob (#5d4037) with single lavender streak (#c7b8ea), large
bright amber-gold eyes (#ffb300), oversized blush-pink wizard
scuffed brown boots (#4e342e), golden friendship bracelets
(#ffd93d) both wrists, ink-smudged fingers, singed robe hem,
tiny star scar on chin, determined concentrated expression with
tongue peeking out | BRAM: human boy 8, tall lanky build, pale
olive skin, floppy dark brown curls (#3e2723), wide warm brown
